subject: Using one widget to update another widget

messages.author: 51977c1bbc6b38c4
messages.subject: Using one widget to update another widget
parts:
Hello,

Just wondering if anyone has some sample code to use one UI widget to update another UI widget.

For example, I am wanting to use a select box to update a slider. The user could also directly use the slider as well.

Thank you, Evan

messages.author: d6ebe55625e8e5a2
messages.subject: Re: Using one widget to update another widget
parts:
You can use a combination of an observer + the appropriate updateXxxInput function. For example, for the use case you describe, here's a minimal exmaple:

library(shiny)

ui <- fluidPage(
  selectInput("slc", "Update slider value to", c(0, 25, 50, 100)),
  sliderInput("sld", "Slider", 0, 100, 50)
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  observeEvent(input$slc, {
    updateSliderInput(session, "sld", value = input$slc)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
